findingDetails.title: The history-engine CI step cannot resolve tsc on a clean runner
findingDetails.case: a push touching .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit triggers runtime-vitest; the engine build runs ../../../skills/system-spec-kit/node_modules/.bin/tsc, which no install step provisions, so the job fails before any test runs
findingDetails.evidence: the build script hardcodes .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/node_modules/.bin/tsc; spec-kit-check.yml:181-194 and 276-286 install .opencode/skills/system-spec-kit and the .skilled root only; .skilled/skills is a real directory and .skilled/package.json declares no workspaces and no scripts
findingDetails.scopeProof: rg -n npm-ci-retry .github/workflows/spec-kit-check.yml lists every install target and none is .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit; jq .workspaces and .scripts on .skilled/package.json both null; ls -ld .skilled/skills shows a directory; the tsc path resolves only through a machine-local install
findingDetails.claim: The runtime-vitest history-engine build step fails on a clean GitHub runner because its hardcoded tsc path is never installed.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: checked whether .skilled/skills is a symlink to .opencode/skills (it is not), whether .skilled/package.json declares workspaces or a postinstall (neither), whether any workflow step installs .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit (none), and whether the local path exists only from a machine-local install (it does)
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: a runner image or repo hook could pre-provision the nested node_modules; nothing in the workflow, the package manifests or the tracked tree does, and node_modules is gitignored
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: a workflow step, .skilled package script or runner image is shown to install .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit before line 301

findingDetails.title: Engine-only changes never run the engine vitest suites
findingDetails.case: a commit changing only .skilled/hooks/session-handover/history/lib/lookup-offer.ts runs no suite that imports it, because the one job that runs the .vitest.ts files has no matching trigger path
findingDetails.evidence: the push and pull_request path filters omit .skilled/hooks/**; the engine step at 296-302 is the only invoker of the history package test script; the always-on hooks config include glob at .skilled/hooks/vitest.config.ts:40 does not match the .vitest.ts suffix that history/vitest.config.ts:12 collects
findingDetails.scopeProof: rg -n 'npm --prefix .skilled/hooks/session-handover/history' .github/workflows returns only spec-kit-check.yml:301-302; the hooks include glob and the history include glob are disjoint on the .vitest.ts suffix

findingDetails.title: The projection schema test degrades to a skip when the schema file is missing
findingDetails.case: a later engine move or a mistaken delete removes history-entry.schema.json; the suite reports one skipped test and CI passes while projected entries are validated against no schema
findingDetails.evidence: the published-schema block is guarded by existsSync and substitutes a skip; the path resolves today so the branch is currently dead, but nothing asserts that the schema exists
findingDetails.scopeProof: the guard at line 141 is the only existence check; the resolved path at lines 26-34 points into the moved engine lib; no sibling test asserts the file presence

findingDetails.title: The pinned 66-character bound is only behaviourally pinned in one direction
findingDetails.case: an edit raises the hook-state copy to 67; the engine boundary cases at 64 plain and 70 quoted stay green, so the schema accepts an id the offer refuses and the two bounds drift apart silently
findingDetails.evidence: the copy and the engine agree today at 66 with an identical quote transform, but the constant is module-private and no test reads it; the engine boundary arithmetic derives from its own constant
findingDetails.scopeProof: rg -n 'LOOKUP_OFFER_MAX_QUOTED_SESSION_ID' .skilled returns the private declaration only; rg over history tests returns imports but no value pin; the arithmetic at history-locator.vitest.ts:154-155 cannot distinguish 66 from 67
